triage.instructions: An npm package just published this release. Using only the facts in the state, how should a security reviewer treat it?

criteria.routine: an ordinary release by the usual maintainers; nothing needs a look
criteria.review: legitimate-looking, but a change in the facts deserves a human look before adoption
criteria.likely_malicious: the facts point to a compromised or attacker-controlled release

script_intent.instructions: Does the install-time script shown in the state do something other than build, compile or set up this package (for example download, exfiltrate, run obfuscated code or touch credentials)?

criteria.false: it only builds or sets up the package
criteria.true: it does something unrelated to building the package
